notes: Calvary Chapel movement church; verse-by-verse expository preaching. YOUTUBE FOUND: @CalvaryTucson ('Calvary Tucson with Robert Furrow', channel id UChCwipJRbp62_7SF0yq6Ghg) - the earlier note saying no channel was confirmed is now superseded. Sermons are also archived on the church site at calvarytucson.com/teachings (indexed by book of the Bible and by teacher) and streamed at live.calvarytucson.com. TWO CAMPUSES, both confirmed on the church's own footer: West Campus 5170 S Julian Drive, Tucson AZ 85706 (this is also the main office; services Sun 8:45 and 11:15 AM, Wed 7:15 PM) and East Campus 8711 E Speedway Boulevard, Tucson AZ 85710 (Sun 10 AM, Wed and Sat 6 PM). This record still carries the East/Speedway address; if the map ever needs both campuses, the West/Julian address above is verified. PASTORS: only Robert Furrow (Lead Pastor) and Troy Stokoe (Associate Pastor) are recorded, because they are the two people on calvarytucson.com/people whose entries carry a 'Teachings' link, and the two most recent weekly teachings were both Furrow. The staff page also lists Paul Almquist and Johnny Coate (Pastor & Worship Leader), Jim Arnold, John Hallcock and Adam Parsons (Pastor), Donnie Back Jr. (Kids), Steven Coleman (Youth), Dan Swanson (Young Adults) and lay pastors Douglas Blaser and Bart Goodwin; several of these names appear in the teachings-by-teacher index, but that index also contains 200+ outside speakers (Alistair Begg, Skip Heitzig, Frank Turek and so on), so appearing there is NOT proof of being a regular Sunday preacher. Confirm from the dated teachings archive before adding any of them as a preaching pastor.
